Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 demonstrates bilateral alveolar-interstitial opacities that are more prominent in the lower lung zones, while Figure 4 shows a marked progression to dense, diffuse bilateral consolidations. This rapid worsening of airspace disease is characteristic of severe pulmonary pathology such as diffuse alveolar hemorrhage or ARDS, distinguishing it from resolution, isolated nodules, or simple heart failure.
